notes.title: Bug fixes, more localizations, trading cards, and more!
notes.content:
First things first, the price has been lowered to $9.99 (or your regional equivalent). To celebrate the release of this update, we're also having a 15% off sale lasting a week!

🔧 [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
We've addressed various issues people were having when running the game on modern systems. If you encounter more bugs, please let us know in the community discussions!

🌍 [b]More Localizations[/b]
The game now supports Czech, French, German (voiced), Italian, Polish, Russian (voiced), and Spanish.

✅ [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b]
We've made sure the new build of the game works flawlessly with the Steam Deck!

☁️ [b]Steam Cloud Saves[/b]
Safeguard your saves and continue your adventure with Mona across any of your devices.

ːmona_smugː [b]Steam Trading Cards & Library Assets[/b]
Since we're already here making updates, we've taken the opportunity to add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/313870/]emotes[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/313870/]backgrounds[/url], trading cards,  and badges. We spruced up the library art as well!

That's all for now, we hope you enjoy these additions and fixes. Thank you for your support, and happy gaming!
